选择与表单

上传 AsamUpload

默认 resource 模式上传后保存规范化资源，显式 native 模式维护原始 fileList。

使用场景 ​

默认 resource 模式上传后保存规范化资源，显式 native 模式维护原始 fileList。两种模式的模型、事件与实例方法各有契约。

资源上传、校验与取消 ​

示例只使用本地异步 handler，不发送网络请求。upload 返回包含 id/name/url/mimeType/size 的资源；context 提供取消信号与进度报告。maxSizeBytes/validate 在上传前检查文件。复制源码包括 handler。

资源上传、校验与取消

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{
				...{ accept: '.txt' },
				...{
					upload: localUpload,
					'max-size-bytes': 1048576,
					validate: validate,
					'auto-upload': false
				}
			}"
			v-model="value"
			@success="event = 'success'"
			@error="(error) => (event = error.message)"
			@cancelled="event = 'cancelled'"
		>
			<template #trigger>
				<AsamButton type="default">选择文本文件</AsamButton>
			</template>
			<template #tip>本地演示，单个 TXT，最大 1 MiB</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.submit()">上传</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.cancel()">取消</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clear()">清除</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>资源：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}；{{ event }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadResourceExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadExpose, AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { localUpload } from './upload';
const control = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const value = ref<AsamUploadedResource | null>(null);
const event = ref('尚未上传');
function validate(file: File) {
	return file.name.endsWith('.txt') || '仅接受 TXT';
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.density-grid {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
}

section {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
	min-width: 0;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>
ts
import type { AsamUploadHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export const localUpload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: file.size });
	await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
		const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 250);
		context.signal.addEventListener(
			'abort',
			() => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				reject(new Error('cancelled'));
			},
			{ once: true }
		);
	});
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new Error('cancelled');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: file.name + ':' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/local-demo/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
		size: file.size
	};
};

多文件与文件插槽 ​

multiple 模型必须是资源数组。file 插槽提供 item、file、index、remove、cancel；保留移除和取消入口。progress 由 handler 的 reportProgress 更新。

多文件与文件插槽

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamUpload
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ ...{ upload: localUpload, limit: 3 }, ...{ multiple: true, drag: true } }"
		>
			<template #trigger>拖入文件或点击选择（最多三个）</template>
			<template #file="{ item, remove, cancel }">
				<span>{{ item.name }} · {{ item.status }} · {{ item.percent ?? 0 }}%</span>
				<AsamButton type="default" @click="remove">移除</AsamButton>
				<AsamButton type="default" @click="cancel">取消</AsamButton>
			</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<output>资源：{{ value }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}

js
export const localUpload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 250);
		context.signal.addEventListener(
			'abort',
			() => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				reject(new Error('cancelled'));
			},
			{ once: true }
		);
	});
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new Error('cancelled');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: file.name + ':' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/local-demo/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
		size: file.size
	};
};

照片墙、缩略图、校验与重排

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="controls">
			<div class="control-field">
				<label for="control-listType">列表类型</label>
				<AsamSelect id="control-listType" v-model="listType">
					<AsamOption :label="'text'" :value="'text'">text</AsamOption>
					<AsamOption :label="'picture'" :value="'picture'">picture</AsamOption>
					<AsamOption :label="'picture-card'" :value="'picture-card'">
						picture-card
					</AsamOption>
				</AsamSelect>
			</div>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="allowRemoval">允许移除</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="custom">自定义缩略图</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-model:file-list="files"
			mode="native"
			:list-type="listType"
			:auto-upload="false"
			:http-request="upload"
			:disabled="disabled"
			accept="image/*"
			crossorigin="anonymous"
			:on-progress="(event) => progresses.push(event.percent)"
			:on-change="() => changes++"
			:before-remove="beforeRemove"
			:before-upload="beforeUpload"
			:on-preview="preview"
			:on-success="(_response, file) => (result = `已上传 ${file.name}`)"
			:on-error="(_error, file) => (result = `上传失败 ${file.name}`)"
			:on-remove="(file) => (result = `已移除 ${file.name}`)"
		>
			<template #tip>选择图片后可手动提交；移除由异步 beforeRemove 判定。</template>
			<template v-if="custom" #file="{ file, index }">
				<div class="thumbnail">
					<AsamImage v-if="file.url" :src="file.url" :alt="file.name" />
					<span>{{ index }}：{{ file.name }} / {{ file.status }}</span>
					<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="disabled" @click="preview(file)">
						预览 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="control?.handleRemove(file)"
					>
						移除 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="disabled" @click="control?.abort(file)">
						取消 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.submit()">提交照片</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="files.reverse()">重排照片</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clearFiles(['success'])">
				清除成功照片
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>
			{{ result }}；{{ files.map((file) => file.name).join(',') }}；进度
			{{ progresses.join(',') }}；change 次数 {{ changes }}
		</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadGalleryExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamImage,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps, AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const listType = ref<'text' | 'picture' | 'picture-card'>('picture-card');
const custom = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const allowRemoval = ref(false);
const result = ref('照片墙与受控重排');
const progresses = ref<number[]>([]);
const changes = ref(0);
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	options.onProgress(Object.assign(new ProgressEvent('progress'), { percent: 50 }));
	if (options.file.name.includes('fail')) throw new Error('本地失败演示');
	return { local: true, name: options.file.name };
};
const beforeUpload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeUpload']> = (file) => {
	const valid = file.type.startsWith('image/') && file.size <= 1024 * 1024;
	if (!valid) result.value = '只接受 1MB 以内图片';
	return valid;
};
const beforeRemove: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeRemove']> = async () => {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
	if (!allowRemoval.value) result.value = '移除被 beforeRemove 拒绝';
	return allowRemoval.value;
};
const preview: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onPreview']> = (file) => {
	result.value = `预览 ${file.name}`;
};
</script>

					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="control?.handleRemove(file)"
					>
						移除 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="disabled" @click="control?.abort(file)">
						取消 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.submit()">提交照片</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="files.reverse()">重排照片</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clearFiles(['success'])">
				清除成功照片
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>
			{{ result }}；{{ files.map((file) => file.name).join(',') }}；进度
			{{ progresses.join(',') }}；change 次数 {{ changes }}
		</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadGalleryExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamImage,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref();
const files = ref([]);
const listType = ref('picture-card');
const custom = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const allowRemoval = ref(false);
const result = ref('照片墙与受控重排');
const progresses = ref([]);
const changes = ref(0);
const upload = async (options) => {
	options.onProgress(Object.assign(new ProgressEvent('progress'), { percent: 50 }));
	if (options.file.name.includes('fail')) throw new Error('本地失败演示');
	return { local: true, name: options.file.name };
};
const beforeUpload = (file) => {
	const valid = file.type.startsWith('image/') && file.size <= 1024 * 1024;
	if (!valid) result.value = '只接受 1MB 以内图片';
	return valid;
};
const beforeRemove = async () => {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
	if (!allowRemoval.value) result.value = '移除被 beforeRemove 拒绝';
	return allowRemoval.value;
};
const preview = (file) => {
	result.value = `预览 ${file.name}`;
};
</script>

				</template>

			</div>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadAvatarControlExample' });
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamImage, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadExpose, AsamNativeUploadProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const emit = defineEmits({ notice: (message: string) => typeof message === 'string' });
const uploadRef = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const imageUrl = ref('');
const result = ref('尚未选择头像');
const requests = ref(0);
const successes = ref(0);
let alive = true;
function notice(message: string): void {
	result.value = message;
	emit('notice', message);
}
const beforeUpload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeUpload']> = (file) => {
	if (file.type !== 'image/jpeg') {
		notice('拒绝：只接受 JPG');
		return false;
	}
	if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
		notice('拒绝：文件超过 2 MiB');
		return false;
	}
	return true;
};
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async () => {
	requests.value++;
	notice('本地上传中');
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
	return { local: true };
};
const onSuccess: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onSuccess']> = (_response, file) => {
	if (!alive || !file.raw) return;
	const nextUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file.raw);
	if (imageUrl.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl.value);
	imageUrl.value = nextUrl;
	successes.value++;
	notice(`头像已更新：${file.name}`);
	uploadRef.value?.clearFiles();
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	uploadRef.value?.abort();
	if (imageUrl.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl.value);
	imageUrl.value = '';
});
</script>

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadDirectoryExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';

};

	return { local: true, path: options.file.webkitRelativePath };
};

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadHooksExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps, AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const result = ref('原生请求参数与覆盖前一个文件');
const request = ref('');
let uid = Date.now();
const replace: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onExceed']> = (selected) => {
	const file = selected[0];
	if (!file) return;
	control.value?.clearFiles();
	control.value?.handleStart(Object.assign(file, { uid: ++uid }));
};
const data: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['data']> = async (file) => ({
	category: 'demo',
	original: file.name
});
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	request.value = JSON.stringify({
		action: options.action,
		method: options.method,
		headers: options.headers,
		data: options.data,
		name: options.filename,
		withCredentials: options.withCredentials,
		file: options.file.name
	});
	result.value = '本地请求已完成';
	return { local: true };
};
</script>

upload handler 和 request 二选一。 完整说明。

资源 transport、转换、取消和回填

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用资源操作</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">transport 失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="invalid">transform 失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			multiple
			:request="request"
			:limit="2"
			:auto-upload="false"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:max-size-bytes="1024"
			field-name="document"
			:data="{ category: 'demo' }"
			:validate="(file) => file.name.endsWith('.txt') || '只接受 TXT'"
			@success="(_resource, item) => (event = `success:${item.name}`)"
			@progress="(item) => (event = `progress:${item.percent}`)"
			@error="(error) => (event = `${error.kind}:${error.message}`)"
			@cancelled="(item) => (event = `cancelled:${item.name}`)"
			@remove="(resource) => (event = `remove:${resource.name}`)"
		>
			<template #tip>独立 provider，不影响页面中其他示例；最多两个资源。</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.submit()">提交资源</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.cancel()">取消资源请求</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clear()">清空资源</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="runtime.setScope(String(++scope))">
				切换资源作用域
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="fill">外部回填</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>{{ event }}；请求：{{ input }}；资源：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</output>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadRequestExample' });
import { onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton,
	asamDataRuntimeKey,
	createAsamDataRuntime
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadExpose, AsamUploadRequestConfig } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<AsamUploadedResource[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const disabled = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);
const invalid = ref(false);
const event = ref('尚未提交');
const input = ref('');
const scope = ref(0);
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
runtime.install({
	upload: async (config, payload, context) => {
		input.value = `${config.method}:${config.url}:${payload.fieldName}:${payload.data?.category}`;
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: payload.file.size });
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 150);
			context.signal.addEventListener(
				'abort',
				() => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new Error('cancelled'));
				},
				{ once: true }
			);
		});
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('本地 transport 失败');
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: payload.file.size, total: payload.file.size });
		return invalid.value ? null : { key: payload.file.name };
	}
});
provide(asamDataRuntimeKey, runtime);
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
const request: AsamUploadRequestConfig = {
	url: '/local-resource',
	method: 'put',
	params: { demo: true },
	transform(response, { file }) {
		if (
			!response ||
			typeof response !== 'object' ||
			!('key' in response) ||
			typeof response.key !== 'string'
		)
			throw new Error('响应缺少资源 key');
		return {
			id: response.key,
			name: file.name,
			url: '/local/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
			mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
			size: file.size
		};
	}
};
function fill(): void {
	value.value = [
		{ id: 'seed', name: 'seed.txt', url: '/seed.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', size: 4 }
	];
}
</script>

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用资源操作</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">transport 失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="invalid">transform 失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			multiple
			:request="request"
			:limit="2"
			:auto-upload="false"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:max-size-bytes="1024"
			field-name="document"
			:data="{ category: 'demo' }"
			:validate="(file) => file.name.endsWith('.txt') || '只接受 TXT'"
			@success="(_resource, item) => (event = `success:${item.name}`)"
			@progress="(item) => (event = `progress:${item.percent}`)"
			@error="(error) => (event = `${error.kind}:${error.message}`)"
			@cancelled="(item) => (event = `cancelled:${item.name}`)"
			@remove="(resource) => (event = `remove:${resource.name}`)"
		>
			<template #tip>独立 provider，不影响页面中其他示例；最多两个资源。</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.submit()">提交资源</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.cancel()">取消资源请求</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clear()">清空资源</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="runtime.setScope(String(++scope))">
				切换资源作用域
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="fill">外部回填</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>{{ event }}；请求：{{ input }}；资源：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadRequestExample' });
import { onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton,
	asamDataRuntimeKey,
	createAsamDataRuntime
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref([]);
const control = ref();
const disabled = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);
const invalid = ref(false);
const event = ref('尚未提交');
const input = ref('');
const scope = ref(0);
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
runtime.install({
	upload: async (config, payload, context) => {
		input.value = `${config.method}:${config.url}:${payload.fieldName}:${payload.data?.category}`;
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: payload.file.size });
		await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 150);
			context.signal.addEventListener(
				'abort',
				() => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new Error('cancelled'));
				},
				{ once: true }
			);
		});
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('本地 transport 失败');
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: payload.file.size, total: payload.file.size });
		return invalid.value ? null : { key: payload.file.name };
	}
});
provide(asamDataRuntimeKey, runtime);
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
const request = {
	url: '/local-resource',
	method: 'put',
	params: { demo: true },
	transform(response, { file }) {
		if (
			!response ||
			typeof response !== 'object' ||
			!('key' in response) ||
			typeof response.key !== 'string'
		)
			throw new Error('响应缺少资源 key');
		return {
			id: response.key,
			name: file.name,
			url: '/local/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
			mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
			size: file.size
		};
	}
};
function fill() {
	value.value = [
		{ id: 'seed', name: 'seed.txt', url: '/seed.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', size: 4 }
	];
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

.controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);

transform 返回合法 id/name/url/mimeType/size 资源，失败、重复 id 和错误 metadata 不写入模型。 完整说明。

cancel/clear/作用域失效及卸载中止 context，迟到完成不会写回；进度、成功、错误、cancelled、remove 事件保持各自 payload。 完整说明。

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 扩展为 resource/native 双模式与四档密度。 完整说明。

API 阅读方式 ​

下方 Props、Events、Slots、Exposes 按当前实际公开类型与运行默认值生成。组合属性按分支生效，不能任意混搭值模式。标为“未知 / 未声明”的默认值不代表 false 或空值。源码区域提供对应语言的独立 Demo.vue，可直接复制或下载；本地辅助组件、数据和素材已内联到当前文件。

完整工程配置与本组件全部场景

完整工程 ZIP 包含此组件的全部场景；vendor 正常包保留在 ZIP 中，下方逐文件查看源码与工程配置。

<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><component :is="current" :key="selected" />
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const options = [
	{ value: 'resource/ts', label: '资源上传、校验与取消 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'resource/js', label: '资源上传、校验与取消 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'multiple/ts', label: '多文件与文件插槽 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'multiple/js', label: '多文件与文件插槽 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'native/ts', label: '原始文件列表与手动提交 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'native/js', label: '原始文件列表与手动提交 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'sizes/ts', label: '四档尺寸与上下文继承 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'sizes/js', label: '四档尺寸与上下文继承 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'gallery/ts', label: '照片墙、缩略图、校验与重排 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'gallery/js', label: '照片墙、缩略图、校验与重排 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'directory/ts', label: '目录选择与拖放相对路径 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'directory/js', label: '目录选择与拖放相对路径 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'hooks/ts', label: '限制覆盖、原生请求与手动提交 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'hooks/js', label: '限制覆盖、原生请求与手动提交 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'request/ts', label: '资源 transport、转换、取消和回填 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'request/js', label: '资源 transport、转换、取消和回填 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'avatar/ts', label: '头像替换、类型大小校验与对象 URL 回收 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'avatar/js', label: '头像替换、类型大小校验与对象 URL 回收 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'resource/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/resource/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'resource/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/resource/js/Demo.vue')),
	'multiple/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/multiple/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'multiple/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/multiple/js/Demo.vue')),
	'native/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/native/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'native/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/native/js/Demo.vue')),
	'sizes/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sizes/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'sizes/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sizes/js/Demo.vue')),
	'gallery/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/gallery/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'gallery/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/gallery/js/Demo.vue')),
	'directory/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/directory/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'directory/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/directory/js/Demo.vue')),
	'hooks/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/hooks/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'hooks/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/hooks/js/Demo.vue')),
	'request/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/request/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'request/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/request/js/Demo.vue')),
	'avatar/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/avatar/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'avatar/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/avatar/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('resource/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadResourceExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadExpose, AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { localUpload } from './upload';
const control = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const value = ref<AsamUploadedResource | null>(null);

function validate(file: File) {

}

ts
import type { AsamUploadHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export const localUpload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: file.size });
	await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
		const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 250);
		context.signal.addEventListener(
			'abort',
			() => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				reject(new Error('cancelled'));
			},
			{ once: true }
		);
	});
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new Error('cancelled');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: file.name + ':' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/local-demo/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
		size: file.size
	};
};

					'max-size-bytes': 1048576,
					validate: validate,
					'auto-upload': false
				}
			}"
			v-model="value"
			@success="event = 'success'"
			@error="(error) => (event = error.message)"
			@cancelled="event = 'cancelled'"
		>
			<template #trigger>
				<AsamButton type="default">选择文本文件</AsamButton>
			</template>
			<template #tip>本地演示，单个 TXT，最大 1 MiB</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.submit()">上传</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.cancel()">取消</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clear()">清除</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>资源：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}；{{ event }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadNativeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadExpose, AsamNativeUploadProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const event = ref('尚未上传');
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = (options) => {
	options.onSuccess({ local: true });
	return Promise.resolve({ local: true });
};
</script>

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="density-grid">
			<section data-density="large">
				<strong>large</strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<span class="mode-label">原生模式</span>
					<AsamUpload size="large" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<span class="mode-label">资源模式</span>
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.large"
						size="large"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="big">
				<strong>big</strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<span class="mode-label">原生模式</span>
					<AsamUpload size="big" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<span class="mode-label">资源模式</span>
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.big"
						size="big"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="default">
				<strong>default</strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<span class="mode-label">原生模式</span>
					<AsamUpload size="default" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<span class="mode-label">资源模式</span>
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.default"
						size="default"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="small">
				<strong>small</strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<span class="mode-label">原生模式</span>
					<AsamUpload size="small" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<span class="mode-label">资源模式</span>
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.small"
						size="small"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :size="density">
			<section data-density="inherited">
				<div data-mode="native">
					<span class="mode-label">原生模式 · 继承</span>
					<AsamUpload mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<span class="mode-label">资源模式 · 继承</span>
					<AsamUpload v-model="inheritedModel" :upload="upload" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="override">
					<span class="mode-label">原生模式 · 显式 small</span>
					<AsamUpload size="small" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
			</section>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div class="row" role="group" aria-label="继承尺寸">

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadGalleryExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamImage,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps, AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const listType = ref<'text' | 'picture' | 'picture-card'>('picture-card');
const custom = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const allowRemoval = ref(false);
const result = ref('照片墙与受控重排');
const progresses = ref<number[]>([]);
const changes = ref(0);
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	options.onProgress(Object.assign(new ProgressEvent('progress'), { percent: 50 }));
	if (options.file.name.includes('fail')) throw new Error('本地失败演示');
	return { local: true, name: options.file.name };
};
const beforeUpload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeUpload']> = (file) => {
	const valid = file.type.startsWith('image/') && file.size <= 1024 * 1024;
	if (!valid) result.value = '只接受 1MB 以内图片';
	return valid;
};
const beforeRemove: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeRemove']> = async () => {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
	if (!allowRemoval.value) result.value = '移除被 beforeRemove 拒绝';
	return allowRemoval.value;
};
const preview: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onPreview']> = (file) => {
	result.value = `预览 ${file.name}`;
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadHooksExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps, AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const result = ref('原生请求参数与覆盖前一个文件');
const request = ref('');
let uid = Date.now();
const replace: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onExceed']> = (selected) => {
	const file = selected[0];
	if (!file) return;
	control.value?.clearFiles();
	control.value?.handleStart(Object.assign(file, { uid: ++uid }));
};
const data: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['data']> = async (file) => ({
	category: 'demo',
	original: file.name
});
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	request.value = JSON.stringify({
		action: options.action,
		method: options.method,
		headers: options.headers,
		data: options.data,
		name: options.filename,
		withCredentials: options.withCredentials,
		file: options.file.name
	});
	result.value = '本地请求已完成';
	return { local: true };
};
</script>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadHooksExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref();
const files = ref([]);
const result = ref('原生请求参数与覆盖前一个文件');
const request = ref('');
let uid = Date.now();
const replace = (selected) => {
	const file = selected[0];
	if (!file) return;
	control.value?.clearFiles();
	control.value?.handleStart(Object.assign(file, { uid: ++uid }));
};
const data = async (file) => ({
	category: 'demo',
	original: file.name
});
const upload = async (options) => {
	request.value = JSON.stringify({
		action: options.action,
		method: options.method,
		headers: options.headers,
		data: options.data,
		name: options.filename,
		withCredentials: options.withCredentials,
		file: options.file.name
	});
	result.value = '本地请求已完成';
	return { local: true };
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadRequestExample' });
import { onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton,
	asamDataRuntimeKey,
	createAsamDataRuntime
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadExpose, AsamUploadRequestConfig } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<AsamUploadedResource[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const disabled = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);
const invalid = ref(false);
const event = ref('尚未提交');
const input = ref('');
const scope = ref(0);
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
runtime.install({
	upload: async (config, payload, context) => {
		input.value = `${config.method}:${config.url}:${payload.fieldName}:${payload.data?.category}`;
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: payload.file.size });
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 150);
			context.signal.addEventListener(
				'abort',
				() => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new Error('cancelled'));
				},
				{ once: true }
			);
		});
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('本地 transport 失败');
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: payload.file.size, total: payload.file.size });
		return invalid.value ? null : { key: payload.file.name };
	}
});
provide(asamDataRuntimeKey, runtime);
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
const request: AsamUploadRequestConfig = {
	url: '/local-resource',
	method: 'put',
	params: { demo: true },
	transform(response, { file }) {
		if (
			!response ||
			typeof response !== 'object' ||
			!('key' in response) ||
			typeof response.key !== 'string'
		)
			throw new Error('响应缺少资源 key');
		return {
			id: response.key,
			name: file.name,
			url: '/local/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
			mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
			size: file.size
		};
	}
};
function fill(): void {
	value.value = [
		{ id: 'seed', name: 'seed.txt', url: '/seed.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', size: 4 }
	];
}
</script>

	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);

.controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

				</template>

			</div>
		</AsamUpload>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadAvatarControlExample' });
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamImage, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadExpose, AsamNativeUploadProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const emit = defineEmits({ notice: (message: string) => typeof message === 'string' });
const uploadRef = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const imageUrl = ref('');
const result = ref('尚未选择头像');
const requests = ref(0);
const successes = ref(0);
let alive = true;
function notice(message: string): void {
	result.value = message;
	emit('notice', message);
}
const beforeUpload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeUpload']> = (file) => {
	if (file.type !== 'image/jpeg') {
		notice('拒绝：只接受 JPG');
		return false;
	}
	if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
		notice('拒绝：文件超过 2 MiB');
		return false;
	}
	return true;
};
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async () => {
	requests.value++;
	notice('本地上传中');
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
	return { local: true };
};
const onSuccess: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onSuccess']> = (_response, file) => {
	if (!alive || !file.raw) return;
	const nextUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file.raw);
	if (imageUrl.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl.value);
	imageUrl.value = nextUrl;
	successes.value++;
	notice(`头像已更新：${file.name}`);
	uploadRef.value?.clearFiles();
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	uploadRef.value?.abort();
	if (imageUrl.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl.value);
	imageUrl.value = '';
});
</script>

# AsamUpload 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.
VueUse shared and metadata 15.0.0 carry the same license text as core. The
following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

原生照片墙、缩略图与受控重排 ​

native 模式完整承接 text、picture、picture-card 三种 listType。onPreview 处理预览动作；beforeUpload 可同步/异步拒绝文件或返回替换后的 File/Blob，返回 false/Promise rejection 会阻止上传。beforeRemove 可同步/异步拒绝移除，onRemove 在实际移除后调用；onChange 会在选择、成功、失败时收到当前列表。native file 插槽原样接收原生 { file, index }，移除和取消通过实例 handleRemove(file) / abort(file) 调用。item/remove/cancel 仅属于 resource file 插槽；旧 native 用法需按照片墙示例迁移。

原生照片墙、缩略图与受控重排 ​

v-model:fileList 为受控原始列表，使用方可重排或外部替换；uid 保持文件身份。picture 和 picture-card 的缩略图使用 file.url；组件负责自身生成的对象 URL 生命周期。crossorigin 按实际图片来源配置。disabled 禁止选择和原生列表操作；资源模式也禁止默认取消、移除按钮，实例方法仍由使用方控制。

隐藏列表后的头像替换 ​

下面使用 native、showFileList=false 和 default 插槽呈现选择入口，成功后以头像替换入口内容。beforeUpload 拒绝非 JPG 或超过 2 MiB 的文件；accept 是选择器提示，不能替代验证。httpRequest 是本地 Promise，onSuccess 只在成功后用原始 File 创建预览，不发网络请求。拒绝文件不会替换已有头像。

目录选择和拖放路径 ​

目录上传由 native 的 directory 承接。目录选择依赖浏览器 webkitdirectory 支持；拖放目录展开后保留原始文件的 webkitRelativePath，而不是只留下最后一级文件名。multiple 接收展开的文件集合，httpRequest 的 options.file 同样保留路径，存储端可以据此构造相对目录。

目录选择和拖放路径 ​

resource 模式保持规范化资源模型，其 transport 输入是原始 File；不会擅自将目录层次塞入资源 id/url。目录选择 UI 和照片墙由 native 明确承接；resource 的 file 插槽可呈现宿主已有资源缩略图。需要资源路径时由 upload/request transform 按宿主协议生成，不能将 native fileList 与 resource modelValue 混搭。

数量限制、覆盖和请求钩子 ​

limit 与 onExceed 组合控制超量选择。覆盖单文件时先 clearFiles，再给新 File 赋 uid 并 handleStart；handleRemove 走原始移除流程。autoUpload=false 将文件留在 ready，submit 发送待传列表。showFileList、accept、drag、multiple、disabled 直接控制原生 UI。trigger 是选择入口，存在 trigger 时 default 可放独立提交动作，tip 为提示区域。

数量限制、覆盖和请求钩子 ​

原生请求参数 action/method/headers/name/data/withCredentials 交给 httpRequest；data 支持对象、函数和 Promise。onProgress 接收进度事件，onSuccess/onError 接收结果和原始列表。自定义 httpRequest 可返回 Promise（由组件调用成功/失败钩子）或 XMLHttpRequest（abort 可中止其请求）；Promise 的物理取消由自定义请求实现负责，不能仅凭调用 abort 宣称异步操作已终止。clearFiles 可按 ready/uploading/success/fail 过滤，禁止在 beforeUpload 中清列表。

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

upload handler 和 request 二选一。request 包含 url、post/put、params、同步 transform，实际上传由注入的 provider.upload 执行；示例以独立 runtime/provide 隔离，不改变其他示例。transport 输入保留 File、fieldName 和字符串/Blob data；context.signal 与 reportProgress 分别支持取消和进度。loaded/total 必须有效，未知 total 显示无百分比状态；超量进度不当成成功。

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

transform 返回合法 id/name/url/mimeType/size 资源，失败、重复 id 和错误 metadata 不写入模型。maxSizeBytes/validate/limit 在传输前判定；配置错误、transport 错误和 transform 错误分别通过 error.kind 表明来源。未完成或失败文件不进入 modelValue。多文件模型必须数组，单文件空值为 null；外部回填重新显示已有资源，资源模型与 native 原始文件列表保持分离。

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

cancel/clear/作用域失效及卸载中止 context，迟到完成不会写回；进度、成功、错误、cancelled、remove 事件保持各自 payload。disabled 禁止默认资源选择、取消和移除操作；自定义 file 插槽的按钮和外部实例方法由使用方控制。实例 abort/clearFiles/handleStart/handleRemove 为原生文件桥接，submit/cancel/clear 为资源操作；全部操作的结果以真实模型与列表为准。

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 扩展为 resource/native 双模式与四档密度。resource 的 upload 与 request 二选一；request 需要 provider 上传 transport 与 transform，不混用 native action。resource 公开 submit/cancel/clear；native 公开 abort、submit、clearFiles、handleStart、handleRemove。单个资源空值为 null，多资源为空数组。
